# Dental Appointment Voice Agent — Template

Vapi + n8n: availability, booking, cancellation, rescheduling and human callback requests.

## Required setup
- Connect your Google Sheets and Gmail credentials.
- Select your spreadsheet and worksheet in every Google Sheets node (appointments or callbacks). Configure append/update column mappings and matching columns.
- Set the recipient in every Email Clinic node.
- Replace YOUR_CLINIC_NAME and YOUR_AGENT_NAME in messages.
- Replace YOUR_DENTIST_1 and YOUR_DENTIST_2 in schedule code and their lowercase equivalents in all three validation nodes.
- Configure CLINIC_SLOTS in both schedule nodes and BUSINESS_DAYS in Find Verified Alternative Slots.
- Connect your Vapi tools to the webhook URLs generated by your n8n instance.
- Test all four routes before activating.

Credentials, resource selections, clinic schedule settings, personal email, pinned data and instance metadata have been removed. Workflow logic and request field names are retained. This template requires configuration before it can run.

# 1 · Dentist availability

Validates the requested dentist, appointment type, date and time. If the slot is occupied, it searches the configured clinic schedule and returns two verified alternatives.

# 2 · Book an appointment

Creates a caller-confirmed dental appointment, generates a short DEN-#### ID, stores patient and visit details, responds to Vapi and notifies clinic staff.

# 3 · Cancel or reschedule

Matches the appointment ID with the patient phone number. Confirmed requests update the existing record rather than deleting it.

# 4 · Human callback

Validates and records requests for insurance verification, clinical questions, complaints, cancellation-list requests or other staff follow-up.
